name: Shōbara (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shōbara city emblem in green and yellow: green stylised leaves cradling a yellow disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shōbara, a city in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 31 March 2005.

features.role: Shōbara city emblem — green stylised leaves cradling a yellow disc
